thread:
Nora: Flagging a couple of README snippet drifts spotted during onboarding calls today. New users hit two different auth bugs in sample-app: Ruby curl header mismatch and Go client constructor change.
Nora: Ruby snippet from README (copy/paste):
```ruby
require 'net/http'
uri = URI('https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat')
req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
req['Api-Key'] = ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY']
req.body = { messages: [] }.to_json
res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, use_ssl: true) { |http| http.request(req) }
puts res.body
```
Nora: That header returns 401; we only accept `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Diego: Also the Go sample in the same README still uses the old constructor: `client := redwood.NewClient("$REDWOOD_API_KEY")` but the SDK now expects a config struct: `redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{APIKey: os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")})`. New users copy the old form and hit nil-pointer panics.
Priya: Oof. Which repo/file?
Nora: docs/onboarding/sample-app/README.md lines ~30-70. I'm attaching the snippets in the thread.
docs-bot: Snippet-linter report: mismatched header usage detected in README.md -> Api-Key header (expected Authorization). Also detected deprecated Go constructor pattern in codeblock at line 52. Report ID: DB-2026-03-23-01.
Casey: I'm on it. Quick plan: replace Ruby header with `Authorization` example, and update Go snippet to use the Config struct + error handling. Add a one-liner about token rotation and show curl + Ruby examples for Bearer token.
Nora: Can we also normalize env var names? The Go sample uses `REDWOOD_TOKEN` while other samples use `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Pick one. I vote `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.
Diego: Agreed. We'll standardize to REDWOOD_API_KEY across samples. I'll prepare a small script to grep for `REDWOOD_TOKEN` / `REDWOOD_KEY` in the samples repo and open a PR.
Priya: Suggest adding a tiny acceptance snippet run in docs CI that curls the endpoint with a fake token to ensure header form is correct (we can assert 401 with header missing or 401 vs 403 to detect header shape). infra-bot: note: we should not call prod endpoints from CI; use simulated lint or offline parser.
Casey: Ok, we can run a local snippet validator that checks for header names and constructor shapes without invoking the API. I'll add it to samples/verify-snippets.sh.
Diego: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 - updates Ruby and Go snippets, normalizes env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY, and adds a CONTRIBUTING note to run snippet validator.
Nora: Thanks. After merge, can someone add a short changelog in the README about the auth header change so users searching issues find it?
Priya: Will file a small follow-up to add a changelog blurb.
Casey: docs-bot: please re-run snippet-linter after PR lands and post result.
docs-bot: Will do. Preview deployed for PR #812: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr-812 - snippet linter green. :white_check_mark:
Nora: Great, closing this thread after merge. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :raised_hands:
